title: When the Ones Fill a Ten

steps.body: Sometimes adding the ones makes a full ten. When that happens, ten ones bundle into one new ten.
steps.narration: Sometimes adding the ones makes a full ten. When that happens, ten ones bundle into one new ten.

widget.prompt: You have 6 in the frame. Add enough to make ten.
widget.missFeedback: Fill one square at a time, counting as you go.
widget.successFeedback: Ten filled — 6 needed 4 more to make a whole ten.

predict.prompt: 6 is in the frame. How many more are needed to make a whole ten?
predict.reveal: Ten take away 6 is 4 — that is exactly how many more squares are empty. Whatever number is in the frame, the empty squares always show ten minus that number.
